idea-plugin.name: Ever Present Filenames
idea-plugin.description:
Displays the current file name at the bottom-right corner of the editor. The filename stays visible even when scrolling through the file.
Features: - Blue dot indicator and italic text when file has unsaved changes - Cyan border for focused editor, gray for unfocused editors - Left click to copy absolute file path to clipboard - Right click for context menu with options to copy file name, relative path, or absolute path
